newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Prop rights issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Allied Prop rights issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Property group Allied Properties (H.K.) Ltd said on Friday its HK$628 million rights share issue was oversubscribed.
The company said it received applications for a total 522.53 million rights shares, representing 108 percent of the total of 483.41 million rights shares available for subscription.
On completion, the company's major shareholder Allied Group Ltd will hold 51.15 percent of the company, it said.
In March, Allied Properties proposed to distribute the rights shares in the proportion of one rights share for every five existing shares held at an issue price of HK$1.30 each.
